headline: Pakistan in Energy Crisis: Foreign Travel and Official Banquets Banned, Only One Dish at Wedding Invitations
summary: Pakistan has banned foreign travel and official banquets and limited wedding invitations to one dish as part of measures to address an energy crisis. The curbs are aimed at reducing energy use.
why: Energy shortages and fuel costs weigh on Pakistan's inflation, growth and external accounts, which matter for investors in its economy and sovereign debt.
